mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entitlement_anomaly( order_id, user_id, item_key, anomaly_type, detail, status ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{itemKey}, #{anomalyType}, #{detail}, 'OPEN' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE detail = VALUES(detail), status = 'OPEN', resolved_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE entitlement_anomaly SET status = 'RESOLVED', resolved_at = NOW(3) WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND item_key = #{itemKey} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entitlement_anomaly WHERE status = 'OPEN'
